interface.signature: def getHappyString(n: int, k: int) -> str

preconditions.description: The length of the happy string n must be between 1 and 10 inclusive.
The position k must be between 1 and 100 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value in ['a', 'b', 'c'] * (n == 1) or return_value == '' or (len(return_value) == n and all(return_value[i] != return_value[i + 1] for i in range(n - 1)) and return_value in generate_happy_strings(n))
postconditions.description: The return value must be the k-th lexicographical happy string of length n, or an empty string if there are fewer than k such strings.
